utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a decent turnout already—people’ve been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, I can walk with you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? Are people actually bringing a lot already? I might stop by with you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, quite a bit already—boxes of nails, a couple power tools, even some paint cans. If you’re ready, I can head over with you now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading over to the repair drive later, and I’ll let folks know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might swing by if I remember. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep you posted if the timing shifts or anything new comes up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you help me sort donations at the community center first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can do that. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we need tools, duct tape, spare bulbs, and any extension cords you can spare. If you can check your garage and bring what you find, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll check my garage and bring whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, so just let me know when the repair drive needs us and I’ll see what fits.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Faye — I’ll check the repair drive timing and send you the slots that fit the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Jules — send me the options when you have them, and I’ll work around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a simple plan for the repair drive—what needs doing first, and when should we start?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — first we should sort out the biggest broken items and make a quick list of what needs tools. I can start tomorrow morning if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tomorrow morning works for me. Let’s start with the biggest broken items and make that tool list first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. We should get a good turnout if we invite everyone nearby.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, Quinn. I’m just hoping we have enough tools and volunteers lined up so it all runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll ask around for extra tools and volunteers today. If you know anyone reliable, send them my way and I’ll invite them too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—what should I be telling folks about it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Tell folks we’re gathering small repairs, tools, and a few handy volunteers this Saturday. If they can share the flyer or spread the word on the block, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll tell people to bring small repairs, tools, and any handy volunteer time this Saturday, and I’ll spread the flyer on the block too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara. Could you check what parts are still missing and whether we need any tools before I start?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I hear you — I can keep it simple too and just jump in late if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’d really appreciate that — I’ll let you know when I can manage more.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring whatever tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Gus—what time should we meet, and should I bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let’s meet at 9 by the community shed, and if you can bring work gloves and water, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — appreciate it. Just ping me if the location shifts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll let you know right away if the repair drive location changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. That’d really help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help — I’ll swing by with the toolbox and a few spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit cautious about the timing and pickup details—what exactly do we need to drop off, and when?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s confirm the list and the pickup time before we commit. Do you know exactly what needs to go and who’s handling the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the full list yet, so I’d like to confirm it first. If we can get the pickup window and who’s driving, I can help coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and see who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Jules—thank you. Let me know who’s interested, and I’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send you a list of names soon. Happy to help keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a bit late, but I can still help. Let me know what supplies are missing and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Dane — I’ll check our list and tell you what’s still missing. If you can grab any nails, tape, or spare screws, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of interest already — folks are really showing up for it. If you want, I can keep you posted on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — please do keep me posted. I’m trying to work around school pickup and drop-off, so any updates would really help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new. I’ll keep an eye out for timing changes, too, so it’s easier to fit around school runs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, got it — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you help me confirm the repair list and spread the word to the neighbors? I’ll keep everything organized and let you know the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that. Send me the repair list and I’ll pass it around to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help sort the donated tools and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, the repair drive’s getting organized — want me to pass along the invite when I hear the details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please do — I’d really appreciate that. I’m still catching up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along as soon as I get the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard any update yet — do you know where the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have the exact spot yet, but I can check and let you know. I’ll follow up as soon as I hear where it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — I’d appreciate the update when you get it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, what time does the repair drive start, and do you need any help?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina, thanks for asking. I’m checking the start time now, and I’ll let you know if I need help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Just let me know when you’ve got the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — if I hear anything, I’ll pass it along right away.
